name: Royal Gems
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE game-piece collection sheet for Royal Gems, consisting of exactly SIX isolated pieces.
Primary request: Premium bright cartoon match-3 game art, smoothly sculpted 3D pieces. Bold inflated silhouette, very broad clean highlights, soft ambient occlusion, rich solid color, only a few broad facets. Charming polished toy gems, NOT realistic jewelry. Each silhouette distinct. No thin rims or metallic outlines. These should feel like the best polished modern casual puzzle game.
Composition: precisely 1536x1024 landscape image divided into an INVISIBLE equal 3-column by 2-row grid. Cells are 512x512. Put one piece dead center in each cell at these centers: (256,256), (768,256), (1280,256), (256,768), (768,768), (1280,768). Each piece fits in a centered 320x320 bounding box, with ample empty margin. All six have equal apparent visual mass and size. Front view with a slight shared upper-front view showing volume, same lighting from upper left.
Reading order left-to-right top-to-bottom: a ruby-red plump HEART; a sapphire-blue rounded SHIELD, entirely blue with a simple lighter-blue inset, no gold rim; an emerald-green FOUR-LEAF CLOVER with a very short stem; a sunshine-yellow THREE-POINT CROWN, no jewels; a saturated violet faceted HEXAGONAL GEM; a tangerine-orange ROUND MEDALLION with a simple sun relief.
Background: perfectly flat uniform very dark navy #101D35 across the entire canvas. NO gradients, texture, cast shadows on the background, grid lines, frames, pedestals or cards. Soft self-shading is allowed only ON the objects. This plain background is for asset extraction.
Constraints: color must fill each piece, each is primarily ONE of the six specified colors. Crisp separated silhouettes. Exactly six pieces, no extras. No captions, text, numerals, watermarks, UI, game board, or decorative stars. The pieces must occupy their assigned grid centers accurately.
